response.sql: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) as member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), stats AS (SELECT member_count, CAST(member_count AS REAL) / SUM(member_count) OVER () as share, AVG(CAST(member_count AS REAL) / SUM(member_count) OVER ()) OVER () as avg_share FROM major_counts) SELECT SUM(member_count) as total_members, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_above_average FROM stats WHERE share > avg_share
